name: Schaukäserei Kasplatzl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Schaukäserei Kasplatzl in Tirol**

Discover the art of traditional Tyrolean cheese-making at **Schaukäserei Kasplatzl**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Here, you can watch skilled artisans craft authentic **Tiroler Bergkäse** and other regional specialties right before your eyes.

Indulge in fresh, homemade **Käsebrezeln**, **Käsekrainer**, or a hearty **Käsespätzle** platter while enjoying the rustic charm of this family-run dairy. Don’t miss their famous **Tiroler Graukäse**—a creamy, slightly tangy delight that pairs perfectly with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Apfelwein**.

Whether you’re a cheese lover or simply curious about **Tirol’s** culinary traditions, **Schaukäserei Kasplatzl** offers an unforgettable taste of the Alps. Visit us in **Innsbruck** or **Landeck** and experience the warmth of **Tirol’s** dairy heritage firsthand.
